title: China-Linked TA416 Targets European Governments with PlugX and OAuth-Based Phishing
summary:
A China-aligned threat actor has set its sights on European government and diplomatic organizations since mid-2025, following a two-year period of minimal targeting in the region.

title: Why Third-Party Risk Is the Biggest Gap in Your Clients' Security Posture
summary: The next major breach hitting your clients probably won't come from inside their walls. It'll come through a vendor they trust, a SaaS tool their finance team signed up for, or a subcontractor nobody in IT knows about.
